name: Amazing Marvin
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For Amazing Marvin, build a configurable personal task system from strategies, views, timers, and reviews. The hard boundary is very deep strategy library, cross-platform sync, and years of workflow experimentation, plus cross-device reliability and workflow polish.
